meta.title: Modular Football Pitches — Configure & Request a Quote
meta.description: Modular football pitches and cages with steel frames and plywood boards. Configure size, height and branding, see the price live, and request an offer.

home.title: Your pitch. Anywhere.
home.subtitle: Steel frames, plywood boards, your branding. Built in modules, set up in hours — for clubs, cities, events and brands.
home.lineupSubtitle: Five standard formats. Every one customisable.

pick.title: Pick
pick.text: Choose a pitch type that fits your space and your players.

configure.title: Configure
configure.text: Set the size, height, branding and extras. The price updates live.

offer.title: Get an offer
offer.text: Add pitches to your cart and request a quote. We reply with a PDF offer.

home.referencesSubtitle: Street tournaments, school yards, brand activations and club training grounds.

modular.title: Modular
modular.text: Bolt-together boards. Set up and take down in hours.

durable.title: Durable
durable.text: Galvanised steel frames and weather-proof plywood.

branded.title: Branded
branded.text: Logos or full wrap on one or both sides.

taglines.the-cage: The full cage. Boards and bars, 2.5 m high.
taglines.the-pitch: The classic. Boards all around, ready for any event.
taglines.kids-pitch: Small players, big games. Low boards, small goals.
taglines.panna-cage: One-on-one in a cage. Octagon with bars.
taglines.panna-pitch: The street duel. Compact octagon, low boards.

product.customise: Everything is customisable: size, height, branding, fencing behind goals, frame colour, artificial turf and installation.
